# Parse the note content to extract TODO songs
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
        parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            song_part, release_part = parts
            if release_part == 'TODO':
                # song_part is "Title BY Artist1, Artist2"
                # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
                if ' BY ' in song_part:
                    title, artists_str = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
                    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                    todo_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
print(todo_songs)

steps.code:
# Search for each TODO song on Spotify and find the matching release date
import re

release_months = {}
for song in todo_songs:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Search with title and first artist to narrow down
    query = f"{title} {artists[0]}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_limit=20)
    # Find the exact match: title matches and all artists are present
    match = None
    for r in results:
        if r['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            result_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in r['artists']]
            # Check if all expected artists are in the result artists
            if all(any(exp.lower() == ra for ra in result_artists) for exp in artists):
                match = r
                break
    if match:
        # Extract release month from release_date (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)
        release_date = match['release_date']
        # Parse the date part
        date_part = release_date.split('T')[0]
        year, month, _ = date_part.split('-')
        release_months[title] = f"{month}/{year}"
        print(f"{title}: {release_months[title]}")
    else:
        print(f"NO MATCH for {title}")

print("\nAll release months collected:")
print(release_months)

import re

new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    # Skip header line
    if line.startswith('#'):
        new_lines.append(line)
        continue
    # Extract title from the line: "- Title BY ... RELEASED_AT TODO"
    # Pattern: "- <title> BY <artists> RELEASED_AT <month>"
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY .+ RELEASED_AT (.+)$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1)
        current_release = m.group(2)
        if current_release == 'TODO' and title in release_months:
            new_release = release_months[title]
            # Replace the TODO with the new month
            new_line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {new_release}')
            new_lines.append(new_line)
        else:
            new_lines.append(line)
    else:
        new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
